derivation_shape_to_check_later: c_K g_{k+1}^2 >= c_K g_k^2 L(g_k)^2 when L(g_k)>=0
rho c_K g_k^2+C_K g_k^4 <= c_K g_k^2 L(g_k)^2 when M(g_k)>=0

verify the one-step norm and every constant use exactly the source scale indices and graph-ball scope
compose O1-O4 to the smaller c_K g_{k+1}^2 radius only
